description: Wand-aimed casting: the held wand visibly orients so its tip axis points along runtime.aim.direction while aiming or casting, with the pitch clamped to the camera's world-space ground limits, while projectiles keep spawning from the (now correctly pointed) wand tip. Independent of FEAT-002/003 — touches only the player avatar/rig and a new pure helper; no economy, SpellRuntime, or save change. Grounded in design.md §5 and design-review.md Finding 1 and the Verified Assumptions.
steps: Create src/game/player/wandAim.ts with three pure exports: WAND_LOCAL_AXIS = new Vector3(0,-1,0); clampWorldAimPitch(aimDir, limits = CAMERA_LIMITS.groundPitch): Vector3 that clamps the WORLD-space pitch (worldPitch = asin(clamp(aimDir.y,-1,1)); clampedPitch = clamp(worldPitch, limits[0], limits[1]); yaw = atan2(aimDir.x, aimDir.z)) and rebuilds a unit vector (sin(yaw)*cos(clampedPitch), sin(clampedPitch), cos(yaw)*cos(clampedPitch)); wandAimRotation(parentSpaceAimDir): Quaternion = normalize then Quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(WAND_LOCAL_AXIS, dir). Import CAMERA_LIMITS from ../camera/CameraRig — do NOT re-hardcode [-1.2,0.55].

Create src/game/player/wandAim.test.ts asserting: clampWorldAimPitch of an above-limit input returns y === Math.sin(CAMERA_LIMITS.groundPitch[1]) (sin 0.55) within 1e-6; a below-limit input returns y === Math.sin(CAMERA_LIMITS.groundPitch[0]) (sin -1.2); yaw (atan2(x,z)) is preserved by the clamp; a mid-range unit input round-trips unchanged; and wandAimRotation(dir) applied to WAND_LOCAL_AXIS reproduces several representative unit dirs within ~5 degrees (dot >= cos(5deg)).

In src/game/player/HumanoidRig.tsx add wandRoot: Object3D | null to the HumanoidHandle interface; add a useRef<Object3D>(null) and attach it as ref on the existing <group rotation-x={0.25} position={[0,-0.02,-0.02]}> under handR (the group holding the wand mesh and the wandTip empty at [0,-0.36,0]); return wandRoot from useImperativeHandle.

In src/game/player/PlayerAvatar.tsx ProceduralAvatar.useFrame, after blender.apply(...) and BEFORE reading r.wandTip into runtime.wandTip: compute a damped aim factor k that ramps 0->1 while runtime.player.aiming OR (runtime.player.castStartedAt >= 0 && now - runtime.player.castStartedAt < 0.4), reusing dampFactor, and gate k to ground/non-flying states so it never fights the broom pose. When k > 0 and r.wandRoot exists: clampWorldAimPitch(runtime.aim.direction) in world space, transform the clamped world dir into the wand group's PARENT space via r.wandRoot.parent.getWorldQuaternion(tmp).invert(), compute wandAimRotation(localAimDir), and slerp r.wandRoot.quaternion toward it by k. Keep the existing missing-node fallback (runtime.wandTip.set(x, y+1.4, z)).

In src/game/player/PlayerAvatar.tsx RealisticAvatar: leave behaviour unchanged (it exposes c.wandTip but no settable wand group) and add a one-line comment that the correction applies only when a settable wand group is exposed and the procedural path (characterLibraryAvailable() is false) carries the feature.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run src/game/player/wandAim.test.ts passes all new assertions (clamp extremes equal sin(0.55)/sin(-1.2), yaw preserved, mid-range round-trip, rotation within ~5deg).
npm run typecheck passes with wandRoot added to HumanoidHandle and consumed in PlayerAvatar.

Code-path trace (AC-1/AC-2): with runtime.player.aiming true, k ramps, r.wandRoot slerps toward the clamped aim, then r.wandTip.getWorldPosition writes runtime.wandTip, and SpellRuntime.tryCast still does ctx.origin.copy(runtime.wandTip) (SpellRuntime.tsx:397 unchanged) so the projectile spawns from the correctly-pointed tip.
spellSystem.test.ts remains unmodified and green; no change to spellSystem.ts, registry.ts, or SpellRuntime.tsx.
verification: Trace design.md §10 trace 1 (wand points along aim) end to end in PlayerAvatar.tsx + SpellRuntime.tsx.
findings: Implemented as designed, no deviations. HumanoidHandle now exposes `wandRoot: Object3D | null` (the <group ref={wandRoot} rotation-x={0.25} position={[0,-0.02,-0.02]}> under handR holding the wand mesh + wandTip empty); wired via a useRef<Object3D>(null) and returned from useImperativeHandle alongside wandTip/joints/root. New pure helper src/game/player/wandAim.ts exports WAND_LOCAL_AXIS=Vector3(0,-1,0), clampWorldAimPitch(aimDir, limits=CAMERA_LIMITS.groundPitch) and wandAimRotation(parentSpaceAimDir); CAMERA_LIMITS is imported from ../camera/CameraRig (not re-hardcoded). In PlayerAvatar.ProceduralAvatar.useFrame the aim factor is `a.aimK` on the anim ref, ramped with dampFactor(12,dt) toward 1 while (p.aiming || (p.castStartedAt>=0 && runtime.time-p.castStartedAt<0.4)) AND !flightPose AND !isAirborneFlightState(runtime.flight.state); `now` is runtime.time (same basis PlayerController uses for the 0.4s cast window). The slerp runs after blender.apply and before reading r.wandTip into runtime.wandTip: clampWorldAimPitch(runtime.aim.direction) in world space, transformed into the wand group's PARENT space via r.wandRoot.parent.getWorldQuaternion(tmp).invert(), then r.wandRoot.quaternion.slerp(wandAimRotation(localAim), a.aimK). Guarded on r.wandRoot && r.wandRoot.parent. Missing-node fallback (runtime.wandTip.set(x,y+1.4,z)) preserved. RealisticAvatar unchanged except a one-line comment noting the correction only applies on the procedural path. Module temporaries added to PlayerAvatar: _parentQuat, _localAim, _aimRot. Verification: npx vitest run src/game/player/wandAim.test.ts -> 5/5 pass; npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint only pre-existing warnings; npm run build succeeds. Full `npm test` baseline before edits was 6 files/82 tests green.
